user.title: Stiebel Eltron infrared
user.description: Choose the infrared emitter to transmit through. A receiver is optional. It lets Home Assistant detect changes made with the physical remote.

reconfigure.title: Stiebel Eltron infrared
reconfigure.description: Change the infrared emitter this appliance transmits through, or add or remove a receiver. The appliance's remembered state is kept. To rename it, use Rename on the entry instead.

error.emitter_in_use: Choose a different emitter. Another Stiebel Eltron of this model is already controlled with this one. Two identical appliances on one emitter cannot be controlled separately because the protocol carries no appliance address.

abort.already_in_progress: Another window is already adding a Stiebel Eltron of this model on this emitter. Finish or cancel that one first.
